svg.title: Allocate Option & Diligence Capital Without Calling It Revenue
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation-comparison; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate Option & Diligence Capital Without Calling It Revenue; subtitle: Four buckets across $15,000, $45,000, and $75,000 startup plans.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: All amounts are USD. Numeric stage values describe the $45,000 reference stack; each stage also identifies the corresponding floor ($15,000) and ceiling ($75,000) allocations for an option-and-assignment / micro-royalty desk. These are alternative capital plans, not additive funding rounds and not mappings to the three annual revenue scenarios. Option earnest deposits and reserves are balance-sheet uses, not recognized royalty or trading revenue.; caption: Floor: $6,000 + $4,000 + $3,000 + $2,000 = $15,000. Reference: $20,000 + $11,000 + $9,000 + $5,000 = $45,000. Ceiling: $35,000 + $18,000 + $14,000 + $8,000 = $75,000.; stages: label: Option earnest deposits and micro-tract acquisition pool; value: $20,000 reference allocation for option/earnest & micro-tract basis; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Floor allocation is $6,000; ceiling allocation is $35,000. Deploy into pooling-docket option contracts and small verified NPRI tranches backed by institutional takeout buyers. Track basis by interest so disposal proceeds do not inflate recognized rights-trading gains.; label: Reserve transaction-specific diligence and title curative; value: $11,000 reference allocation for run-sheet diligence and closing; numeric value: 11000.0; detail: Floor allocation is $4,000; ceiling allocation is $18,000. Cover county recorder run sheets, engineering decline checks, recording, and deed preparation. Separate capitalized acquisition costs from expensed failed-deal work; do not charge the same invoice twice.; label: Hold operating liquidity through the first assignment cycle; value: $9,000 reference allocation for protected operating liquidity; numeric value: 9000.0; detail: Floor allocation is $3,000; ceiling allocation is $14,000. Against lean monthly burns of $1,000–$3,000 during initial sourcing, this reserve bridges the canonical 3–9 month first-deal window before assignment spreads or division-order receipts clear.; label: Provision docket scrapers, GIS stack, and contingency cash; value: $5,000 reference allocation for data stack and contingency; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Floor allocation is $2,000; ceiling allocation is $8,000. Cover state oil-and-gas commission docket feeds, GIS parcel overlays, entity setup, and contingency reserves.

text.title: Option earnest deposits and micro-tract acquisition pool

Deploy into pooling-docket option contracts and small verified NPRI tranches backed by institutional takeout buyers. Track basis by interest so disposal proceeds do not inflate recognized rights-trading gains.
